verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Anytype exposing its own data to external AI assistants through an official MCP server, a local API, and an agents skill. That is the server role. Nothing documents Anytype itself connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools. A knowledge-base app could plausibly ship an AI assistant with MCP client support, so the axis applies, and the server-side evidence does not transfer to this story.
